name: Zero Shiki
source: In order to find their father who has gone missing, the twins Akane and Naomi participate in 'Chariot Fest', a tournament in which people try and amass the most points by destroying robots in an underground maze.
translation: 为了寻找失踪的父亲，双胞胎茜与直美参加了“Chariot Fest”。参赛者要在地下迷宫中摧毁机器人，尽可能积累更多分数。
